1_differential_first_law_n_equals_dPdmu.note: Independent PCHIP interpolants of P(mu) and n(mu) do NOT guarantee n=dP/dmu. The residual measures the violation. The APR source is a thermodynamic table so it should hold to finite-difference precision; the CSS high branch holds by construction (analytic formula).

2_phenomenological_declaration.interpretation_text: Phenomenological CSS high-density phase. Its transition pressure, energy jump and sound speed are model parameters, not a microscopic quark-matter calculation.

3_seidov_scope.scope: Seidov small-core onset criterion only; not a full radial-mode stability calculation

5_roundtrip_gate.note: C7-C9/C11 are reported as finite-difference diagnostics, not standalone proofs
